newsitem.title: USA: Prudential Insurance launches fee-based planning.
newsitem.headline: Prudential Insurance launches fee-based planning.

text.p: Prudential Insurance Co of America said it lauched a program that offers a broad range of fee-based financial planning and investment advisory services to individuals.
The Prudential Preferred Advisors program also provides corporate services to businesses, Prudential said.
The program marks the first time this fee-based service has been offered by the company's insurance group, Prudnetial said.

"We developed this new advisers program to meet the specific needs of a significant segment of our customers who tell us they want an advice-based approach to financial services at a reasonable price," said Joe Mahoney, president of Prudential Preferred Financial Services.
Customers with $60,000-plus household incomes and businesses in need of planning services are the target market, Prudential said.
The customized written plan is based on the client's financial information and objectives, the company said.
The plans typically range in price from $200 to $1,000, depending on their complexity.
